items.name: Late delivery risk on open order lines
items.statement: Choose which open order lines to expedite before they miss their commit date. Late lines cost penalties and repeat business; acting before the commit date is cheaper than apologizing after.

items.name: Order-to-receipt flow and where lines wait
items.statement: Fix the step between order, ship and receipt where order lines wait longest. Cycle time is set by the slowest step; naming it tells the team where to add capacity.

items.name: Supplier on-time performance against peers
items.statement: Put the suppliers that deliver late more often than their peers on a review plan. A few suppliers drive most late receipts; benchmarking against peers makes the review fair.

items.name: Revenue change split into price, discount and volume
items.statement: Explain each month's revenue change by price, discount and volume so the right owner acts. Without the split, a discount-driven drop looks like a demand problem.

items.name: Discount depth per market segment
items.statement: Set the maximum discount per market segment and order priority. Discounts given where they do not move volume are pure margin loss.

items.name: Supplier choice per part from supply cost and availability
items.statement: Pick the supplier and quantity per part that meets demand at the lowest supply cost. Supply cost differs by supplier for the same part; the split decides the cost of goods.

items.name: Customer segments from market segment, balance and order value
items.statement: Pick the customer segments for each sales program. One program for every customer wastes effort on those who would buy anyway.

items.name: Customer lifetime value from order history
items.statement: Set the account coverage and service level per customer value tier. Coverage spent on low-value accounts is taken from high-value ones.

items.name: Weekly demand forecast per part type
items.statement: Set next weeks' supply orders per part type and brand. Supply ordered on last week's volume runs short at peaks and long after them.

items.name: Return risk per order line
items.statement: Choose which order lines get a quality check before they ship. A return costs freight both ways plus the refund; checking the riskiest lines first prevents most of it.

items.name: Parts that depend on one supplier
items.statement: List the parts whose supply depends on one supplier or one nation and qualify a second source. A single-source part stops production when its supplier stops.

items.name: Order desk staffing by day
items.statement: Set the number of clerks per day from expected order arrivals. Orders wait when clerks are short and clerks wait when orders are few.

items.name: Unusual discounts per supplier and customer
items.statement: Review the order lines whose discount breaks the usual range for their part and customer. Out-of-range discounts are either errors or policy breaches; both lose money.

items.name: Credit hold for customers with a negative balance
items.statement: Choose which customers go on credit hold before their next order. Shipping to accounts that do not pay ties up cash and ends in write-offs.
